issues: In `expo-app/src/screens/SignUpScreen.tsx` the `accessibilityRole="textbox"` props on the `TextInput` components are invalid – TypeScript reports that 'textbox' is not assignable to `AccessibilityRole`. Remove these props (lines 71 and 91) to fix the TS compilation error.

The Sign‑Up screen does not provide proper `<label>` elements for the email and password inputs on the web platform. The UI primary‑flow test fills a field by its label text and fails because it only sees a `<Text>` element (React Native) instead of an HTML `<label>`. Add a conditional rendering of `<label>` (with `htmlFor` matching the input `nativeID`) for `Platform.OS === 'web'` and keep the existing `<Text>` for native platforms. Also define a `webLabelStyle` (similar to the one used in `SignInScreen`) for consistent styling. This will allow the test to locate and fill the "Email address" (and "Password") fields.
feedback: The FastAPI backend passes all tests, but the Expo app has two issues blocking the acceptance flow. The TypeScript errors stem from using an unsupported accessibility role on `TextInput`. More importantly, the Sign‑Up screen lacks proper HTML `<label>` associations for the inputs, which prevents the UI flow test from finding the email field. Fixing these will resolve the TypeScript build failure and allow the primary flow test to succeed.
